channel.title: IndieHOT — Indie Game Hot Topics
channel.description: IndieHOT collects indie game news from a set of public sources every day and scores it by rules: engines & tools, publishing & marketing, devlogs, industry & funding, events, reviews & postmortems. Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are shown — no full text is republished.

item.title: Over 25 Unreal Engine games nominated at The Game Awards 2026
item.description: From Phantom Blade Zero to Meccha Chameleon, a look at the 25-plus Unreal Engine games nominated at The Game Awards 2026.

item.title: A lot of experimenting, a lot of learning
item.description: A lab diary on game development, making AI-assisted coding workflows more dependable, and experimenting with generative music tools — the rough edges, unexpected problems, and small wins along the way.

item.title: Marauder: Unreal Engine type mappings from the game's files, without running the game
item.description: Open-source tool Marauder reads the reflection tables straight from a game's executable to build Unreal Engine .usmap mapping files offline, matching runtime-dumped maps across 121 games with no injection needed.

item.title: Building a Game-Based Learning Module for UK Schools: A Pre-Production Checklist
item.description: A learning game for UK schools lives or dies on decisions made before anyone opens an engine — this checklist covers the fixed lessons, shared devices, and curriculum that shape it.

item.title: Tearing through reality: The tech behind Hyper Visor on XREAL AURA
item.description: Owlchemy Labs explains how Hyper Visor unifies gameplay, menus and pausing on XREAL AURA with multiple Unity physics scenes and a single energy stream.

item.title: Real-time 3D with Unity Industry: What to vibe code with Unity CLI and when to rely on the foundational infrastructure
item.description: Unity's own take on where AI-assisted development helps — prototypes and UI — and where teams should buy managed Unity infrastructure instead, for CAD, security and scale.

item.title: Epic Games no longer plans to include Blueprints or Actor Gameplay Framework in Unreal Engine 6
item.description: Epic has changed course: Unreal Engine 6 will drop Blueprints and the Actor Gameplay Framework from day one in favor of AI-driven tooling, so developers used to visual scripting should start planning their migration now.

item.title: Roblox tycoon dropper tutorial: conveyors, upgraders and a collector in one server script
item.description: One server script walks through the full Roblox tycoon loop — dropping, conveying, upgrading and collecting — driven entirely by tags and attributes.

item.title: Tiny Team, Big Swing: 3 Devs, 4 Days, and an AI-Built “Infinity Nikki”?
item.description: A three-person team built a dress-up open-world prototype in four days with AI tools — a look at how far small teams can now push a playable prototype.

item.title: Versioning Save Data Before a Live Update: A Migration Checklist for Your Christmas Patch
item.description: A seasonal patch that wipes progress kills goodwill fast — this checklist covers save versioning and small-step migrations so old saves survive your Christmas update.

item.title: Game Collecting Stories 04: One Box of Games Sold for ¥27,000 — A 2025 Roundup of Mainland China PC Game Collecting
item.description: Mainland retro PC game collecting went academic and digital in 2025: rare items rarely surfaced in public, one box fetched ¥27,000, and museums and scholars are now systematically preserving this slice of Chinese gaming history.

item.title: A Practical Workflow for Agent-Driven 3D Asset Generation
item.description: Treat the LLM as planner and the 3D model as modeller to mass-produce game-ready 3D assets through a division of labour, with an excavator example to show how it works.

item.title: Can Google Genie 4 Make a Game? A Game Developer's Guide
item.description: This developer's guide puts Google Genie 4's game-making abilities to the test, breaking down what it can actually help with across gameplay, art and workflow — and where it falls short.

item.title: What the Top 98 Roblox Games Reveal About Thumbnails, Icons & Personalization (2026 Data)
item.description: Pulling public page data for all 98 games on Roblox's Top Playing Now chart, this piece replaces thumbnail and icon guesswork with real numbers on what actually drives clicks.

item.title: Preparing Your Game for a Nintendo Switch Port: A Technical Readiness List
item.description: Thinking about a Switch port? This checklist walks through performance, input, and submission requirements so you know what the port demands before you start.

item.title: Unreal Engine 6 Will Not Include Blueprints & Gameplay Framework
item.description: Epic says UE6 will drop Blueprints and the Gameplay Framework, and expects AI to make converting UE5 games to UE6 practical and cost-efficient — a major shift in the engine's direction.

item.title: Hot Five: GTA 6's blockbuster launch, layoffs at Jam City, and Google Play's Best of Play 2026 winners
item.description: The week's biggest mobile stories: GTA 6's blockbuster launch, layoffs at Jam City, and Google Play's Best of Play 2026 winners.

item.title: GTA 6 generates $3.79bn in day one sales to become the biggest entertainment launch in history
item.description: Take-Two confirmed GTA 6 generated $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, making it the biggest entertainment launch in history.

item.title: Epic Games will abandon blueprints right at the launch of Unreal Engine 6
item.description: Epic has revised its Unreal Engine 6 plans: even early versions will drop Blueprints and the Actor Gameplay Framework — a big shift for teams built on visual scripting.

item.title: Procedural Unity Tool Creates Venom-Like Tendrils That Wrap Around Any Object
item.description: This procedural Unity tool generates Venom-like tendrils that wrap around any object, offering five visual styles for developers adding organic motion to their scenes.
